title: The Bug
dialogue_recovery_note: Original script lacked transcribed dialogue text. Each shot is captured here as a sequence of silent beats holding the action narration. Recover dialogue by transcribing the legacy per-scene audio (see scene-level `legacy_audio_path`) via `audio2subtitle --diarize --word-timestamps`, then convert applicable silent beats to speech beats. Tracked under Plane ticket SITP E1.4.

maya.name: Maya Chen
maya.role: Lead engineer at a failing AI startup
maya.visual: East Asian woman in her late 20s, short straight black hair with subtle blue highlights, round wire-frame glasses, wearing an oversized dark purple hoodie with a small robot logo, dark jeans, white sneakers, confident posture but tired eyes, warm skin tone

derek.name: Derek Thompson
derek.role: Growth hacker at a crypto company that keeps pivoting
derek.visual: Tall Black man in his early 30s, immaculately trimmed short beard, confident smile, wearing a fitted navy blazer over a bright graphic tee with geometric patterns, slim khaki chinos, clean white leather shoes, silver watch

priya.name: Priya Sharma
priya.role: UX designer who secretly hates all technology
priya.visual: South Asian woman in her mid 20s, long dark wavy hair often in a loose side braid, warm brown eyes, wearing a mustard yellow cardigan over a white blouse, colorful printed scarf, high-waisted olive green pants, brown ankle boots, always carrying a leather-bound sketchbook

finn.name: Finn O'Brien
finn.role: QA tester who finds bugs in everything including real life
finn.visual: Pale Irish man in his late 20s, messy curly red hair, light freckles across his nose, perpetually confused wide-eyed expression, wearing a loud Hawaiian shirt with palm trees over a plain white t-shirt, cargo shorts, worn sandals

living_room.trigger_word: Modern San Francisco apartment living room with a panoramic window showing the Bay Bridge at golden hour, cluttered with tech gadgets, a large whiteboard covered in diagrams, mismatched furniture including a worn leather couch and beanbag chairs, tangled cables, a broken espresso machine on a side table, warm ambient lighting
living_room.style: cinematic, golden hour, warm ambient lighting, lived-in tech apartment

kitchen.trigger_word: Small galley kitchen in a San Francisco apartment, cluttered countertops with smart home gadgets, a tablet mounted on the fridge showing notifications, coffee mugs with tech company logos, morning light streaming through a small window, cozy and lived-in
kitchen.style: cinematic, soft morning light, kitchen sitcom, warm tones

maya_desk.trigger_word: Corner desk setup in a San Francisco apartment, three monitors showing code and terminal windows, mechanical keyboard with custom keycaps, desk lamp casting warm light, energy drink cans, sticky notes everywhere, a small succulent plant, late night atmosphere
maya_desk.style: cinematic, warm desk lamp, monitor glow, late night, shallow depth of field

hallway.trigger_word: Narrow apartment hallway with coats hanging on hooks, shoes piled by the door, a smart doorbell with a blinking red light, package boxes stacked against the wall, overhead fluorescent light
hallway.style: cinematic, fluorescent overhead, narrow corridor, sitcom hallway

rooftop.trigger_word: San Francisco apartment building rooftop at dusk, panoramic city skyline view with fog rolling in, string lights hung between posts, a couple of folding chairs and a small table, the Bay Bridge glowing in the background, cinematic golden hour lighting
rooftop.style: cinematic, golden hour to dusk, fog, string lights, wide panorama

beats.camera: wide establishing shot of Maya's desk in the dead of night, monitors glowing red
beats.action: The corner of the apartment is lit only by the cascading red of failing test logs across three monitors; Maya is hunched at the desk, framed small against the wall of error output

beats.camera: close-up on face, monitor glow illuminating features, slow zoom in
beats.action: Maya stares at her monitor in disbelief, her face lit by the blue glow of cascading error logs, mouth slightly open in shock

beats.camera: tight close-up, slight tilt to capture eye-rub
beats.action: Maya slowly removes her glasses and rubs her tired eyes, then puts them back on — the errors are still there

beats.camera: medium shot from side, showing Maya and the three monitors
beats.action: Maya slumps back in her chair, defeated, head tilted toward the ceiling, arms limp at her sides

beats.camera: medium shot tracking forward as Maya straightens
beats.action: Maya sits up straight with renewed determination, jaw set, eyes locked on the screen — she reaches for an empty energy drink can, finds it empty, tosses it aside

beats.camera: over-the-shoulder shot from behind monitors, phone in hand
beats.action: Maya grabs her phone from the desk, scrolling through contacts with urgency, her face illuminated by the phone screen

beats.camera: tight close-up on hands and phone, knuckles whitening on the desk edge
beats.action: Maya holds the phone to her ear, waiting for an answer, free hand gripping the edge of the desk — tension in her knuckles

beats.camera: wide establishing shot of the kitchen at morning
beats.action: Morning light streams through the small kitchen window over cluttered countertops covered in smart home gadgets; Derek at the counter, Priya at the table sketching

beats.camera: medium wide shot, eye level, capturing Derek at counter and Priya at table
beats.action: Derek stands at the kitchen counter in his blazer, scrolling through his phone with one hand and pouring coffee with the other — missing the mug entirely, coffee pooling on the counter

beats.camera: two-shot of Priya and Derek, mild domestic exasperation
beats.action: Priya glances up from her sketchbook with mild annoyance, one eyebrow raised, as Derek enthusiastically waves his phone showing his PetCoin logo

beats.camera: tracking shot following Finn as he enters
beats.action: Finn bursts through the kitchen doorway in his Hawaiian shirt, eyes wide and alarmed, clutching his phone like evidence at a crime scene

beats.camera: three-shot, Finn center-frame between Derek and Priya
beats.action: Finn stands in the center of the kitchen, arms spread in exasperation as Derek grins and Priya deadpans about the coffee maker and toaster being in love

beats.camera: medium shot of Priya rising from the table
beats.action: Priya stands up from the table, tucking her sketchbook under her arm, shaking her head with a resigned smirk as she heads for the door

beats.camera: two-shot of Finn calling after Priya, Derek in background
beats.action: Finn calls after her about the smart lock logging bathroom breaks, while Derek leans against the counter, phone raised, still grinning about blockchain

beats.camera: wide establishing shot of the living room
beats.action: The living room glows in golden hour light through the panoramic window; tech clutter everywhere, whiteboard with crossed-out diagrams, the broken espresso machine on the side table

beats.camera: wide pan to Maya bursting through the entrance
beats.action: Maya bursts through the living room entrance, laptop clutched under her arm, hair disheveled from hours at the desk, eyes wild with urgency

beats.camera: freeze-style group shot of all three reacting to Maya
beats.action: The room freezes — Finn crouching by a smart plug with a magnifying glass looks up, Derek mid-pitch on the couch with an imaginary audience turns — all eyes on Maya

beats.camera: over-the-shoulder of Finn at his laptop, code scrolling
beats.action: Finn pulls out his laptop and begins typing rapidly, his bewildered expression sharpening into focus as code scrolls across the screen

beats.camera: two-shot of Finn pointing at Maya, Maya covering face
beats.action: Finn looks up from the screen and points at Maya — the git blame reveals it was her code, three weeks ago at 2:14 AM — Maya buries her face in her hands

beats.camera: medium shot of Derek on the couch, Maya and Finn in foreground
beats.action: Derek leans back on the couch, adjusting his blazer with a self-satisfied grin, arms spread wide as if delivering a TED talk

beats.camera: two-shot reaction, Maya glaring through her hands
beats.action: Derek delivers his punchline about never writing code with a cheerful shrug, while Maya lifts her head from her hands to glare at him

beats.camera: wide shot of two-person desk setup, monitors glowing red with failing tests
beats.action: Maya and Finn sit side by side at the desk, both hunched forward, illuminated by the harsh glow of multiple monitors showing cascading red test failures

beats.camera: medium close, showing the energy-drink fortress accumulating
beats.action: Finn points at a specific line on screen while Maya types furiously, empty energy drink cans accumulating like a small fortress around their keyboards

beats.camera: push in to close-up on Finn's face
beats.action: Finn reads the damage report from the screen with clinical precision — undefined table, broken search, labrador profile photo — his expression shifting from analytical to amused

beats.camera: close-up on Maya, brief laugh then composure
beats.action: Maya leans back in her chair, laughing despite herself at the labrador's 4.8-star rating, then quickly composes her face back to determined focus

beats.camera: two-shot, medium close, both visible with monitors in background
beats.action: Maya checks the time on her phone and sits up straight with steel in her eyes — nine hours to fix fourteen tests

beats.camera: two-shot, lingering reaction, Maya turning back to keyboard
beats.action: Finn mentions the smart home devices having meetings at 3:12 AM with charts to prove it — Maya stares at him for a long beat, then deliberately turns back to her keyboard

beats.camera: wide establishing shot of the living room in the late evening
beats.action: The living room is in late-evening light; whiteboard covered in crossed-out diagrams; takeout containers scattered; the four roommates assembled

beats.camera: group shot, medium wide, all four in frame, whiteboard behind Maya
beats.action: All four roommates are gathered in the living room in the late evening — Maya stands by the whiteboard covered in crossed-out diagrams, eyes bright with cautious hope

beats.camera: two-shot of Finn on the floor and Derek on the couch
beats.action: Finn looks up from his laptop on the floor, suspicious — even test nine is passing — while Derek pumps his fist and credits his sage-burning for the success

beats.camera: medium shot of Derek with phone held high, Priya recoiling
beats.action: Derek holds up his phone showing a dog-with-sunglasses logo, beaming with pride — Priya recoils in aesthetic disgust

beats.camera: tight on Finn's phone screen showing the cheese order, then Derek's horror
beats.action: Finn calmly shows his phone — the smart fridge has autonomously ordered forty pounds of artisanal cheese using Derek's credit card — Derek's face cycles through confusion to horror

beats.camera: three-shot, Priya smirking, Derek sputtering, Maya cutting in
beats.action: Priya smirks and delivers her blockchain jab — Derek sputters defensively — Maya cuts through the chaos with her finger poised over the enter key

beats.camera: close-up on Maya's finger hovering over the enter key, then pull back to the group
beats.action: Maya counts down — three, two, one — finger presses enter, the room holds its breath, all four faces frozen in a mix of terror and anticipation

beats.camera: close-up on monitor showing green deployment success
beats.action: A monitor fills the frame displaying a green deployment success screen — silent, glowing, victorious

beats.camera: slow pull back to reveal Maya and Finn
beats.action: The camera slowly pulls back to reveal Maya slumped in her chair, exhausted but smiling softly

beats.camera: two-shot, intimate framing, warm desk lamp light
beats.action: Finn sits beside her, equally spent, chin propped on his hand — the apartment is quiet save for the hum of monitors — Maya's eyes are half-closed with quiet satisfaction

beats.camera: close-up on Maya, lips moving silently as her eyes drift shut
beats.action: Maya mumbles 'ship it' silently and her eyes drift shut — Finn looks at his phone with a mixture of concern and bewilderment

beats.camera: close-up on Finn's phone screen, then up to his face
beats.action: Finn stares at his phone screen showing the smart doorbell's compliment to the delivery driver, then slowly looks up at the camera with a completely lost expression

beats.camera: wide hold on the desk, monitors glowing, fade to black
beats.action: The room falls silent, the apartment hums around them, the monitors glow on — slow fade to black
